purpose: Visible village building priority inventory; a planning aid, not proof of rendered visibility.
coordinateSystem: EPSG:25830 projected to world X=east, Z=north, metres

tierPolicy.A: fixed twenty-ID focus set for spawn, Calle Mayor, church and plaza inspection
tierPolicy.B: remaining buildings within 80 m of any capture aim point
tierPolicy.C: remaining buildings beyond 80 m of every capture aim point
tierPolicy.rank: ascending nearest polygon-to-aim-point distance; OSM way ID breaks ties

visibilityLimit: Distances only. No camera frustum, raycast, screen-space projection, or occlusion test is run.
heightLimit: Fallback levels/type heights may receive a terrain-clearance lift in runtime; the inventory reports the pre-lift value. Roof height and facade construction remain artistic reconstructions.

sources.targetSpecificPnoa: Per-ID reference records, when available, are linked; inspect their image and metadata before treating a roof shape or material as observed.
